levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Fewer than three real items appear in one or more columns, or items are copied across columns without real variation.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: At least three genuine, distinct items appear in each of the three columns.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the chart includes at least two items honestly starred as belonging in more than one column.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The two surprising items are named without any real explanation of why they were surprising.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Both surprising items are named, correctly tied to a column, and each includes a genuine reason for the surprise.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the reasons show the learner noticing a pattern about themselves rather than just restating the item.

lookFors: The hardest-column response names a specific column and a specific reason, not a general 'it was all hard.'
No item on the chart is something the learner admits inventing rather than something real.

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
